name: generate_voiceover
description: Synthesise a voiceover from text (ElevenLabs, Gemini or Kling TTS). Produces a file on disk.

output.description: Path to the generated voiceover audio file (plus duration, vendor and voice)

params.name: text-file
params.description: Path to a file containing the script. Mutually exclusive with --text.

params.name: voice
params.description: Voice (vendor-specific). ElevenLabs: voice_id or premade name. Gemini: prebuilt name (e.g. 'Kore'). Kling: voice_id or TTS_VOICES alias.

params.name: out
params.description: Output audio file path (.mp3 or .wav). Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: vendor
params.description: TTS vendor. Defaults to the first connected: ElevenLabs, Gemini, Kling.

params.name: model
params.description: Override the connector's default model for the chosen vendor

params.name: speed
params.description: Playback speed multiplier. Kling only; ignored for Gemini and ElevenLabs.

params.name: language
params.description: Language hint (e.g. 'en', 'zh'). Kling only; ignored for Gemini and ElevenLabs.
